wording.why: an open fee is replaced only when a checkout was started; otherwise it is re-priced in place

wording.old: Step 3 does not mark any fee paid; an audit row records 'amount_or_intent_mismatch'.

wording.why: two layers refuse a wrong amount; the territory audit row is written only for a payment that no longer matches the fee
